title: Trapdoor Functions with Secure Key Leasing and Copy Protection
summary: Inspired by the no-cloning theorem in quantum theory, a variety of quantum cryptographic primitives with unclonable functionalities, such as secure key leasing and copy protection, have been proposed and attracted significant attention. However, trapdoor functions (TDFs), fundamental primitives in public-key cryptography, have not been extensively studied in these areas. In this work, we initiate a study of TDFs in both secure key leasing and copy protection settings.
